notes: The live controls rebuild materials at run time: the texture select swaps both families' textures and rebuilds them, the right-column select drops parallax occlusion, and the depth slider moves the PBR block through markMaterialUboDirty and rebuilds the Standard one. Native presses the controls; the browser, whose select popups are platform UI, sets them and dispatches the same events, and both wait for the scene's own settings version. The capture frame counts engine frames: the canvas's render loop can start a frame after the Window's. Native against the browser measures 0.057-0.074 (the page's text); each control moves the browser image 0.8 or more.

observe.state: (() => { const canvas = document.getElementById('renderCanvas'); return { search: location.search, dataset: { ...canvas.dataset } }; })()

actions.evaluate: (() => { const select = document.querySelector('select[name=asset]'); select.value = 'wall'; select.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); })()
(() => { const select = document.querySelector('select[name=pom]'); select.value = 'off'; select.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); })()

(() => { const input = document.querySelector('input[name=depth]'); for (const value of ['0.07', '0.08', '0.09', '0.1']) { input.value = value; input.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); } })()
